app.title: Supplier delivery follow-up
toolbar.summary: {{pending}} replies to review · {{delayed}} delayed order lines
queue.emptyBody: Paste a delivery reply from email or chat to start.
orders.emptyBody: Import the sample orders to try the workflow.
review.emptyBody: Pick a supplier reply on the left to review what the assistant extracted.
review.title: Supplier reply
review.confirmHintPending: Decide on the {{count}} remaining proposals first.
review.confirmNoneHint: Every proposal is rejected. Closing marks this reply confirmed and leaves the orders unchanged.
review.sourceHint: Highlighted text is the evidence the assistant cited.
review.noProposals: The assistant has not proposed any changes yet.
review.noProposalsUnresolved: Nothing in this reply maps to an order date. See the note above.
banner.parsingTitle: The assistant is reading this reply
banner.parsingBody: Its tool calls appear in the assistant conversation. This page refreshes when they finish.
banner.incompleteBody: No result after {{minutes}} minutes: the platform may not have started the run (for example the model of the assistant is not authorized), or the run was interrupted. Check the assistant, then parse again; it starts a new chat and each order keeps a single proposal.
banner.followupBody: Ask the supplier for the missing details, or parse again after editing the order data.
banner.confirmedBody: Confirmed by {{user}} on {{time}}. Order dates were updated and logged.
banner.confirmedBodyAnonymous: Confirmed on {{time}}. Order dates were updated and logged.
banner.confirmedNoneBody: Closed by {{user}} on {{time}}. Every proposal was rejected; no order changed.
banner.confirmedNoneBodyAnonymous: Closed on {{time}}. Every proposal was rejected; no order changed.
banner.commandFailed: Parsing was requested, but the assistant conversation could not be opened: {{reason}}
failure.no_delivery_info: The reply does not contain a delivery date.
failure.ambiguous_order: The reply could not be matched to a single order line.
failure.unreadable: The reply could not be read.
failure.model_failed: The model call failed, so the assistant got no answer.
banner.modelFailedHint: This is usually a model configuration or service problem, not the reply. Check the model settings of the assistant, then parse again; each order line keeps a single proposal.
failure.run_stopped: Parsing was stopped in the chat.
banner.runStoppedHint: Parse again when you are ready; it starts a new chat and each order line keeps a single proposal.
proposal.quantityChangeHint: Differs from the order quantity; confirming also changes the order quantity.
proposal.confidenceHint: Self-reported by the model. Check the evidence before accepting.
proposal.stale: This order changed after parsing. Parse again before confirming.
proposal.staleConfirming: Another reply changed this order during confirmation. It can no longer be applied; reject it.
edit.title: Edit proposal
edit.description: Your values replace the assistant's suggestion for {{po}}.
newReply.title: New supplier reply
newReply.description: Paste the supplier's message exactly as received. The assistant only uses this text.
newReply.label: Message
newReply.placeholder: For example: DEMO-001 line 1 is delayed to 2026-11-28 because of maintenance.
newReply.duplicate: This message was already saved, so the existing reply is open.
inspector.title: Order details
inspector.emptyBody: Select a proposal or an order to see its delivery history.
error.confirmation_in_progress: This reply's confirmation hasn't finished. You can only reject proposals whose order changed.
error.order_line_changed: An order changed after parsing. Parse again before confirming.
error.order_line_changed_confirming: Another reply changed an order during confirmation. Reject those proposals, then resume.
error.parse_not_retryable: This reply cannot be parsed again right now.
error.concurrent_change: This reply was changed elsewhere. Refresh to continue.
error.invalid_reply_state: This reply cannot do that in its current state. Refresh to continue.
error.no_proposals: There are no proposals to confirm.
error.proposal_not_found: This proposal no longer exists. Refresh to continue.
error.order_line_not_found: The order line no longer exists.
error.invalid_actor: Your account cannot confirm this reply.
banner.staleBody: {{count}} proposals use old order data. Parse again before confirming, or reject them.
banner.confirmingBody: Confirmation stopped part-way; some changes may already be in the orders. Resume to apply the rest. Nothing is applied twice.
banner.confirmingStaleBody: Confirmation stopped part-way, and another reply has since changed {{count}} of these orders, so they can't be applied. Reject them, then resume to apply the rest.
banner.parsingElapsed: Running for {{elapsed}}; this usually takes 1–3 minutes.
banner.parsingSaved: Proposals saved so far: {{count}}, shown below. You can review them once the assistant finishes.
banner.stalledBody: If the chat still shows the assistant thinking, it is still working; keep waiting. If the chat has stopped (for example after you ended the run), resend it to parse in a new chat; each order line keeps a single proposal. Otherwise it becomes retryable {{minutes}} minutes after parsing started.
banner.retrySafe: The reply text is kept. Parsing again starts a new chat, and each order line keeps a single proposal.
action.acceptAllDone: Accepted {{count}} proposals. Check them, then confirm the {{count}} changes.
review.noProposalsFailed: This parse did not finish, so there are no proposals yet; they appear here after parsing again.
